newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.
newsitem.headline: Highlights of Thursday's Commission briefing.

text.p: Following are highlights of the midday briefing by the European Commission on Thursday:

Spokesman Joao Vale de Almeida said Commissioner Padraig Flynn would meet Slovak Labour and Social Affairs Minister Olga Keltosova in the afternoon and that they would meet the press at 1750/1650 GMT in the Breydel's VIP Corner.

Vale de Almeida said that following recent clonage of sheep in the UK, Commission President Jacques Santer had asked the Commission services to provide the Commission with all the elements regarding its competences in the field of biotechnology. He said the objective was to know if it was necessary, useful and appropriate to take Community action in this matter.

In answer to a question, spokesman Peter Guilford said the Commission was seeking all relevant information from European companies on their Cuban links and the way they were affected by the Helms-Burton Act. He said the information gathering was going fairly well. He denied direct cooperation with countries sympathetic to the EU in its trade dispute with the U.S.
The Commission released the following documents:
- IP/97/167: Moving forward the Bank-SME dialogue - The final report of the Round Table of Bankers and SMEs.
- IP/97/168: Commission clears joint venture of Bodenseewerk Graetetechnik GmbH and EHG Elektroholding GmbH & Co.
- Speech/97/44: Speech by Commissioner Padraig Flynn on European health policy and self-medication.
- Speech/97/45: Speech by Commissioner Hans van den Broek on Cyprus and the European Union.
- Speech/97/46: Speech by Commission President Jacques Santer at Economic and Social Committee plenary session.
- Eurostat news release No 19/97: More competition in EU insurance industry.
- Eurostat- Statistics in focus - Distributive trade, services and transport No 1997-1: Insurance services statistics.
